title: "CM distributions - flaviLib (input)"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Desktop/viromelib")
```

```{r paths}
ROOT    <- "~/Desktop/viromelib"
tax_path <- file.path(ROOT, "data/virus_stats_flaviLib_20260602.csv")
TBLOUT  <- file.path(ROOT, "work/06_infernal/flaviLib/tblout")
fig_dir <- file.path(ROOT, "work/flaviOUT/figures")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

TBLS <- c(
  "cl1a xrRNA" = file.path(TBLOUT, "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm.tbl"),
  "cl1b xrRNA" = file.path(TBLOUT, "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm.tbl"),
  "cl2 xrRNA"  = file.path(TBLOUT, "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm.tbl")
)

missing <- TBLS[!file.exists(TBLS)]
if (length(missing) > 0)
  stop("Missing tblout files:\n", paste(" ", missing, collapse = "\n"))

SIG_ONLY <- TRUE   # TRUE = "!" hits only; FALSE = include "?" marginal

CM_LEVELS  <- c("cl1a xrRNA", "cl1b xrRNA", "cl2 xrRNA", "Unannotated")
CM_COLOURS <- c(
  "cl1a xrRNA"  = "#378ADD",
  "cl1b xrRNA"  = "#1D9E75",
  "cl2 xrRNA"   = "#D85A30",
  "Unannotated" = "#B4B2A9"
)
```

---

## 1. Load taxonomy

The taxonomy CSV has one row per genome accession with family and genus.
Fasta IDs are `accession|region` — match on the accession before the pipe.
Genera with no formal assignment and insect-specific unclassified viruses
are grouped as "Unannotated".

```{r load_tax}
tax <- read.csv(tax_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Total sequences in flaviLib:", nrow(tax), "\n\n")
cat("Family breakdown:\n")
print(count(tax, family, sort = TRUE))
cat("\nGenus breakdown:\n")
print(count(tax, genus, sort = TRUE))
```

---

## 2. Parse cmsearch tblout files

```{r parse_tblout}
read_tblout <- function(path, cm_label) {
  lines <- readLines(path)
  lines <- lines[!startsWith(lines, "#") & nchar(trimws(lines)) > 0]
  if (length(lines) == 0) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(lines, function(l) {
    p <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
    data.frame(
      fasta_id  = p[1],
      E_value   = as.numeric(p[16]),
      score     = as.numeric(p[15]),
      inc       = p[17],
      cm_class  = cm_label,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

cm_all <- do.call(rbind, mapply(read_tblout, TBLS, names(TBLS),
                                SIMPLIFY = FALSE))

# Extract base accession (before pipe) to join with taxonomy
cm_all$accession <- sub("\\|.*", "", cm_all$fasta_id)

cat("All cmsearch hits (! = significant, ? = marginal):\n")
print(with(cm_all, table(cm_class, inc)))
```

---

## 3. CM annotation of input sequences

Each sequence assigned to CM class with best (lowest) E-value. Unmatched = Unannotated.

```{r input_cm}
cm_filt <- cm_all %>%
  { if (SIG_ONLY) filter(., inc == "!") else . }

# Per accession: best hit across all CMs
cm_best <- cm_filt %>%
  group_by(accession) %>%
  slice_min(E_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(accession, cm_class, E_value)

# Join taxonomy with CM hits; exclude Tombusviridae
acc_input <- tax %>%
  filter(family != "Tombusviridae") %>%
  left_join(cm_best, by = "accession") %>%
  mutate(
    cm_class = ifelse(is.na(cm_class), "Unannotated", cm_class),
    cm_class = factor(cm_class, levels = CM_LEVELS),
    genus    = ifelse(is.na(genus) | genus == "", "Unannotated", genus)
  )

# Genus order by total count descending
genus_order <- acc_input %>%
  count(genus, sort = TRUE) %>%
  pull(genus)

acc_input <- acc_input %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order))

cat("=== INPUT CM annotation (n =", nrow(acc_input), "sequences) ===\n\n")

# Overall CM totals
input_cm_totals <- count(acc_input, cm_class) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
print(input_cm_totals)
write.csv(input_cm_totals,
          file.path(fig_dir, "flaviLib_input_cm_totals.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Explicit unannotated summary
unann_total <- input_cm_totals %>% filter(cm_class == "Unannotated")
cat(sprintf("\n%d of %d input sequences (%.1f%%) have no CM hit (Unannotated)\n",
            unann_total$n, sum(input_cm_totals$n), unann_total$pct))

# Unannotated breakdown by family
unann_by_family <- acc_input %>%
  filter(cm_class == "Unannotated") %>%
  count(family, name = "n_unannotated") %>%
  mutate(
    total_in_family = acc_input %>%
      count(family) %>%
      { setNames(.$n, .$family) }[as.character(family)],
    pct_of_family = round(100 * n_unannotated / total_in_family, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_unannotated))
cat("\nUnannotated (no CM hit) by family:\n")
print(unann_by_family, n = Inf)
write.csv(unann_by_family,
          file.path(fig_dir, "flaviLib_input_unannotated_by_family.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# By genus — wide table
input_cm_by_genus <- acc_input %>%
  count(genus, cm_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cm_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
cat("\nBy genus:\n")
print(input_cm_by_genus, n = Inf)
write.csv(input_cm_by_genus,
          file.path(fig_dir, "flaviLib_input_cm_by_genus.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# By family — wide table
input_cm_by_family <- acc_input %>%
  count(family, cm_class) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cm_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))
cat("\nBy family:\n")
print(input_cm_by_family, n = Inf)
write.csv(input_cm_by_family,
          file.path(fig_dir, "flaviLib_input_cm_by_family.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```

---

## 4. Figure: input sequences by genus, coloured by CM class

```{r fig_input, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5}
p_input <- acc_input %>%
  count(genus, cm_class) %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genus, y = n, fill = cm_class)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = CM_COLOURS, name = "CM class", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks()) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("flaviLib input: ", nrow(acc_input),
                      " sequences — cmsearch CM annotation"),
    subtitle = paste0(nrow(acc_input %>% filter(cm_class != "Unannotated")),
                      " with CM hit  |  SIG_ONLY = ", SIG_ONLY),
    x = NULL, y = "Sequences"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))

print(p_input)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "flaviLib_input_accessions_cm.pdf"),
       p_input, width = 8, height = 4.5)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "flaviLib_input_accessions_cm.png"),
       p_input, width = 8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```
